# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 11 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 33 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_011_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 11

**1** Jesus said: "This sky will pass away, and the one above it will pass away.

**2** The dead are not alive, and the living will not die.

**3** In the days when you consumed what is dead, you made it into something living.

**4** When you come to dwell in the light, what will you do?

**5** On the day when you were one, you became two. But when you become two, what will you do?"

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- Cosmic hierarchy implied: this sky and a sky above it; both transient
- "The dead are not alive, the living will not die" — chiastic reversal; defines the two categories absolutely
- "Consumed what is dead, you made it living" — the transformative act of spiritual digestion; the dead (world) is enlivened by the one who consumes it
- "Dwell in the light" — the post-mortem / transformed state
- "Were one, became two" — the movement into duality is the Fall; the question is how to return
